# Launch Screen Assets

Rendered from `ios/Runner/AppIcon.icon/Assets/icon.svg`, whose paths match `assets/images/icon.png`. Each image is a
288-point transparent canvas with the logo's 240-unit artwork scaled into a 108-point square at (90, 90), rendered at
1x, 2x, and 3x with `rsvg-convert`. Light and dark variants are identical.
